In this week's Autocar India Quick News, Mahindra has launched the Bold Edition of the Bolero, while Tesla has upgraded the powertrain for the Model Y L. In two-wheeler news, Bajaj has launched the Pulsar N250SS alongside updating the NS200, while Ducati has launched the Hypermotard V2. Shrey Vaid has all the details.
